# Charlotte Christian School — Branding — Athletics Logo

**Provenance:** Fetched by Claude on 2026-07-25 via web research, to add the school's
athletics mascot logo to the school-page header in the app.

- **School:** Charlotte Christian School (Charlotte, NC)
- **Mascot / teams:** Knights
- **Athletic colors:** Royal blue & white (with black)
- **Logo used in app:** `public/logos/charlotte-christian.png` — primary Knights mark
 (a royal-blue armored knight's helmet with plume, "C" medallion below). 1200×800 PNG,
 transparent background.
